$description: Source of truth for the seeds.hues.flowers design tokens (SPEC tranche-2 §2, item 2.1). Design Tokens Community Group format (2025.10): an object with $value is a token, other objects are groups. The @theme block in v2/app/globals.css is kept in exact sync with this file; v2/tests/unit/tranche-2-1-tokens.test.ts fails if any name or value differs. Consolidation is value-preserving: every value below is the value the site already renders.

badge.$description: Badge family (SPEC tranche-2 section 3, item 2.2): one base construction in globals.css (.badge plus one tone class), one border rule (every tone border clears 3:1 against its own ground; the alphas are Tranche 1.3's shipped values and never move). Tone tokens document the section 3.2 values by referencing the system tokens above; the Small Farm sizes map to @theme variables consumed by SmallFarmBadge. System rule (IRIS-C-06, recorded with the in-stock and small-farm tones): no future placement may put an availability pill and the Small Farm badge in the same row or card header; a surface needing them adjacent comes back to Iris and Mina first.

chip.$description: Chip split (SPEC tranche-2 section 4, item 2.3): .chip-filter (interactive, <a> or <button> only, the 44px house target in both dimensions) vs .chip-tag (inert, <span> only, 32px), plus the .chip-removable modifier with its drawn 14px close glyph. Tokens document the section 4.2 values by referencing the system tokens above; the rules in globals.css carry them. Shared DNA: full radius, 1px line-strong border, surface ground, ink text, sans 14px / 1.5.
